title.zh-CN: 糖尿病多年，消瘦伴下肢水肿 · 73岁男性
title.en: Weight loss and leg swelling in long-standing diabetes · 73-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 一位患糖尿病16年的73岁男性，一年来体重明显下降，近五个月双下肢和阴囊越肿越重，收入病房。
summary.en: A 73-year-old man with sixteen years of diabetes has lost a great deal of weight over a year and for five months his legs and scrotum have swollen more and more; he is admitted to the ward.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表的单例报告改写。本版本（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容，按阶段重新组织并改写为患者的口语，没有增加或改动任何数值、时间、药物或结局；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以相对时间表示。1.0.0版自身的不一致和含糊之处全部保留并列入待核实：出院时水肿“消退”（中文）与“改善”（英文）；利钠肽没有注明是BNP还是NT-proBNP；肌酐只记为95–98 μmol/L这一范围；“MP方案”没有展开药名和剂量；报告诊断“IgG λ型浆细胞骨髓瘤并系统性淀粉样变性”，而记录中没有现行骨髓瘤定义所需的证据。血压约100/60 mmHg在1.0.0版中出自病史，本病例同时作为入院时的血压显示；三个月复查被安排为门诊复诊。对话、决策、干预、评分、工作人员和教学要点为教学设计；没有经审核可用的原图。
notes.en: Adapted from a published single-case report. In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by phase and reworded into the patient's lay speech; no value, timing, drug or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative. Version 1.0.0's own inconsistencies and gaps are kept and listed to verify: the oedema 'subsided' at discharge in the Chinese text but 'improved' in the English; the natriuretic peptide is not named as BNP or NT-proBNP; creatinine is given only as the range 95–98 μmol/L; 'MP' is not expanded into drugs and doses; and the report's diagnosis of 'IgG lambda plasma-cell myeloma with systemic amyloidosis' rests on no recorded myeloma-defining event. The blood pressure of about 100/60 mmHg comes from the history in 1.0.0 and is also shown as his admission reading; the three-month review is staged as a clinic visit. Dialogue, decisions, interventions, scoring, staff and teaching points are educational design; no approved published figure is used.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别长期糖尿病已不能解释病情的信号——一年内非意愿性消瘦、停药后血糖和血压反而下降、非肾病范围蛋白尿伴低白蛋白、舌体增大、温度觉受损而振动觉保留、低电压伴室壁增厚——并按ASH 2026指南送检血清和尿免疫固定电泳及血清游离轻链。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise when long-standing diabetes no longer explains the picture — a year of unintended weight loss, glucose and blood pressure falling off treatment, sub-nephrotic proteinuria with low albumin, an enlarged tongue, lost temperature sense with vibration preserved, low voltage with thick walls — and send serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains (ASH 2026).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用替代部位活检（腹壁脂肪加骨髓，ASH 2026）证实淀粉样物质沉积，并说明刚果红阳性加单克隆蛋白为什么仍需对沉积物作经过验证的分型，以及为什么有单克隆蛋白时不能用骨闪烁显像诊断心脏淀粉样变性。
learningOutcomes.en: Prove amyloid deposition from surrogate biopsies (abdominal fat with bone marrow, ASH 2026), and explain why Congo red positivity with a monoclonal protein still needs validated typing of the deposit, and why bone scintigraphy cannot diagnose cardiac amyloidosis while a monoclonal protein is present.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按IMWG 2014标准区分“伴骨髓浆细胞≥10%的AL型淀粉样变性”与多发性骨髓瘤，说出确诊骨髓瘤还缺哪些骨髓瘤定义事件，并说明AL型淀粉样变性本身就是治疗指征。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply the IMWG 2014 criteria to tell AL amyloidosis with at least 10% marrow plasma cells from multiple myeloma, name the myeloma-defining events the record lacks, and state that AL amyloidosis is itself the indication for treatment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在低血压和浸润性心肌病背景下安全地消肿：静脉袢利尿剂按体重、卧立位血压、肌酐和血钾调整（对磺胺类抗菌药出过皮疹不妨碍用属于非抗菌性磺胺的呋塞米，AAAAI/ACAAI 2022），对低血压、浸润的心脏不用ACE抑制剂、ARB或β受体阻滞剂（心脏淀粉样变中这些药须慎用：ESC 2021立场声明；ACC 2023），不用可致低血糖的降糖药（ADA 2026）。
learningOutcomes.en: Clear oedema safely with low blood pressure and an infiltrative cardiomyopathy: an IV loop diuretic titrated to weight, lying and standing blood pressure, creatinine and potassium (a rash with a sulfonamide antibiotic is no bar to furosemide, a non-antimicrobial sulfonamide: AAAAI/ACAAI 2022), no ACE inhibitor, ARB or beta-blocker for a hypotensive, infiltrated heart (drugs used only with caution in cardiac amyloidosis: ESC 2021 statement; ACC 2023), and no glucose-lowering drug that causes hypoglycaemia (ADA 2026).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在完成分型和分期（肌钙蛋白、NT-proBNP、游离轻链）后选择现行一线方案——达雷妥尤单抗联合硼替佐米、环磷酰胺和地塞米松（ANDROMEDA，2021），按年龄和液体过多把地塞米松减为每周20 mg——而不是当年的美法仑加泼尼松。
learningOutcomes.en: After typing and staging (troponin, NT-proBNP, free light chains), choose today's first line — daratumumab with bortezomib, cyclophosphamide and dexamethasone (ANDROMEDA, 2021), dexamethasone reduced to 20 mg weekly for age and fluid overload — rather than the historical melphalan with prednisone.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用血液学和器官缓解标准判断疗效（Palladini 2012；NT-proBNP进展为升高>30%且>300 ng/L），而不是看利尿后水肿是否消退。
learningOutcomes.en: Judge response by haematological and organ criteria (Palladini 2012; NT-proBNP progression is a rise of more than 30% and more than 300 ng/L), not by oedema that a diuretic has cleared.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 这一年瘦了二十公斤左右，这五个月腿越肿越厉害
chiefComplaint.en: I've lost about twenty kilos this past year, and for five months my legs have been swelling more and more

triageNote.zh-CN: 73岁男性，糖尿病16年、高血压10年，收入病房。近一年体重下降约20 kg；近5个月双下肢水肿，逐渐加重并累及阴囊。目前血压约100/60 mmHg。
triageNote.en: 73-year-old man with 16 years of diabetes and 10 years of hypertension, admitted to the ward. About 20 kg of weight loss over the past year; five months of leg swelling, worsening and now involving the scrotum. Blood pressure about 100/60 mmHg.

tags.en: Swelling of the legs and scrotum

personality.zh-CN: 73岁，得糖尿病十六年了。这一年人瘦了一大圈，腿和阴囊肿得厉害，心里发愁；说话实在，问什么答什么，自己记得的血糖、血压数字也愿意说。
personality.en: 73, with diabetes for sixteen years. He has lost a great deal of weight this year and his legs and scrotum are badly swollen; he is worried, but plain-spoken, answers what he is asked and is happy to give the glucose and blood-pressure numbers he remembers.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 朴实的日常口语，句子短；不用医学术语，血糖、血压只说自己记得的大概数。
speechStyle.en: Plain everyday speech in short sentences; no medical terms; gives glucose and blood-pressure readings only as the rough numbers he remembers.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这一年瘦了二十公斤左右，不知道是怎么回事；腿也肿得厉害。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've lost about twenty kilos this year and I don't know why — and my legs are badly swollen.

concerns.zh-CN: 瘦得这么厉害，是不是得了什么不好的病？
concerns.en: Losing this much weight — is it something bad?

concerns.zh-CN: 降糖药停了，血糖也不高了，我的糖尿病是不是自己好了？
concerns.en: My sugar hasn't been high since I stopped the diabetes medicines — has the diabetes gone away by itself?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 清醒，说话清楚，人很瘦，腿和阴囊肿得厉害，有些发愁。用自己的话说症状，不用术语；只回答问到的内容，不增减数字和时间；不知道的就说说不上来，不要编。三个月后复查时，他是回门诊看结果的。
actingNotes.en: Alert and clear, very thin, with badly swollen legs and scrotum, and worried. Describe symptoms in your own words without medical terms; answer only what is asked and never add or change numbers or times; for anything you do not know, say you are not sure — never invent. At the three-month review he has come back to clinic for his results.

description.en: He has been admitted to the ward with a year of marked weight loss and five months of worsening swelling of the legs and scrotum.

description.en: In the reported course he was treated in hospital with diuresis and MP (melphalan with prednisone) and was discharged once the swelling had gone down; three months later he is back in clinic for review.

text.zh-CN: 原报告的处理经过：利尿，并用MP方案（美法仑联合泼尼松）治疗；水肿消退后出院。本病例没有记录利尿剂的药名和剂量、MP方案的剂量和周期数，也没有记录淀粉样物质分型、血清游离轻链、肌钙蛋白或分期。三个月复查：白蛋白19.9 g/L（入院时24.7 g/L），利钠肽2026 ng/L（入院时1926 ng/L）；原报告认为心脏受累进一步加重。本病例没有记录此后的经过。报告的诊断是IgG λ型浆细胞骨髓瘤并系统性淀粉样变性。这一经过是历史记录，不是教学答案。
text.en: The report's course: diuresis and treatment with the MP regimen (melphalan with prednisone); the oedema went down and he was discharged. This case does not record the diuretic or its dose, the MP doses or number of cycles, nor any amyloid typing, serum free light chains, troponin or staging. At three months: albumin 19.9 g/L (24.7 g/L on admission) and natriuretic peptide 2026 ng/L (1926 ng/L on admission); the report interpreted this as further worsening of cardiac involvement. Nothing later is recorded. The report's diagnosis was IgG lambda plasma-cell myeloma with systemic amyloidosis. This course is the historical record, not the teaching answer.

source.zh-CN: 报告（1.0.0版摘录）：治疗经过与转归（利尿及历史MP方案后水肿消退出院；三个月白蛋白19.9 g/L、钠尿肽2026 ng/L，原报告认为心脏受累加重）；诊断见1.0.0版复盘结论
source.en: Report (version 1.0.0 extract): course and outcome (oedema improved after diuresis and historical MP, discharge; at three months albumin 19.9 g/L and natriuretic peptide 2026 ng/L, interpreted as worsening cardiac involvement); the diagnosis is from the 1.0.0 debrief conclusion

response.zh-CN: 静脉通路已建立。本病例没有记录他的静脉通路是何时建立的。
response.en: The cannula is in. The case does not record when his line was placed.

dose.zh-CN: 呋塞米静脉注射，小剂量起始：此前未用袢利尿剂时常用20–40 mg；若平时已在口服，起始量不低于日常口服剂量（他目前的用药没有记录）。按尿量、每日体重、卧立位血压、肌酐和血钾调整。
dose.en: IV furosemide from a low starting dose: commonly 20–40 mg if he is not already on a loop diuretic, or at least his usual daily oral dose if he is (his current medicines are not recorded). Titrate to urine output, daily weight, lying and standing blood pressure, creatinine and potassium.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。原报告记录他接受过利尿治疗，但没有记录药名、剂量和途径；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. The report records that he was diuresed but not the drug, dose or route; the case does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 每天晨起空腹称体重，记24小时出入量；每天测卧位和立位血压；每天或隔天复查肌酐和血钾；体重下降过快、收缩压下降、出现头晕或肌酐上升时减量。
dose.en: Weigh him every morning and chart his fluid balance; lying and standing blood pressure daily; creatinine and potassium daily or on alternate days; ease off if his weight falls too fast, his systolic pressure drops, he gets dizzy or his creatinine rises.

response.zh-CN: 监测计划已下达。本病例没有记录他的体重、出入量以及利尿期间的血压和肌酐；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The plan is written up. This case does not record his weights, his fluid balance, or his blood pressure and creatinine during diuresis; it does not simulate them.

name.zh-CN: 开始或恢复降压药（如ACE抑制剂雷米普利）
name.en: Start or restart blood-pressure medicine (e.g. the ACE inhibitor ramipril)

dose.zh-CN: 雷米普利2.5 mg口服，每日1次，按血压和肾功能逐渐加量；或恢复他以前的降压药（具体药物没有记录）。
dose.en: Ramipril 2.5 mg orally once daily, titrated up as blood pressure and renal function allow; or restart his previous antihypertensives (which drugs is not recorded).

harm.zh-CN: 他不用任何降压药，血压也只有约100/60 mmHg：现在没有高血压需要治疗。KDIGO 2022指南推荐ACE抑制剂或ARB用于糖尿病合并高血压和白蛋白尿，并按可耐受的剂量调整；血压正常时只是“可以考虑”，而他血压偏低，还有头晕、眼前发黑。在血压为何下降还没查清、心脏和自主神经可能受累时加用降压药，可引起严重低血压、晕厥摔伤和急性肾损伤。先查清他的血压为什么下降，再谈治疗蛋白尿。
harm.en: Off every antihypertensive his blood pressure is about 100/60 mmHg: there is no hypertension to treat. KDIGO 2022 recommends an ACE inhibitor or ARB for diabetes with hypertension and albuminuria, titrated as tolerated, and with normal blood pressure says only that one may be considered — his is low, with dizzy spells and his vision going black. Adding a blood-pressure drug before you know why his pressure fell, with his heart and autonomic nerves possibly involved, risks profound hypotension, syncope with injury and acute kidney injury. Find out why his blood pressure fell before treating the proteinuria.

name.zh-CN: 恢复降糖药（如磺脲类格列齐特）
name.en: Restart a glucose-lowering drug (e.g. the sulfonylurea gliclazide)

dose.zh-CN: 格列齐特缓释片30 mg，每日早餐时口服1次。
dose.en: Gliclazide modified-release 30 mg orally once daily with breakfast.

harm.zh-CN: 他停用降糖药已一年，空腹血糖约4 mmol/L、餐后5–6 mmol/L，一年瘦了约20 kg、胃口差：没有任何降糖指征。磺脲类和胰岛素会引起低血糖，在老年、消瘦、胃口差的人身上可严重而持久。ADA 2026（第6节和第13节）要求对容易发生低血糖的老年人减停胰岛素和磺脲类。长期糖尿病不用药血糖反而正常，本身就是需要解释的警示信号。
harm.en: He has been off diabetes medicines for a year with a fasting glucose of about 4 mmol/L and 5–6 mmol/L after meals, has lost about 20 kg and has a poor appetite: there is no indication to lower his glucose. Sulfonylureas and insulin cause hypoglycaemia that can be severe and prolonged in an older, wasted man with a poor appetite; the ADA 2026 Standards (sections 6 and 13) deintensify insulin and sulfonylureas in older adults at risk of hypoglycaemia. Normal glucose without treatment after sixteen years of diabetes is itself a warning sign to explain.

dose.zh-CN: 请血液科医生会诊，共同制定检查和治疗方案。
dose.en: Ask the haematologist to see him and agree the work-up and treatment.

response.zh-CN: 血液科医生会来看他。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The haematologist will see him. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 请心内科医生会诊，共同评估心脏受累和利尿方案。
dose.en: Ask the cardiologist to assess the heart involvement and share the diuretic plan.

response.zh-CN: 心内科医生会来看他。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The cardiologist will see him. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 请营养科评估营养状况，制定营养支持方案。
dose.en: Ask the dietitian to assess his nutrition and plan support.

response.zh-CN: 营养科会来评估。本病例没有记录营养评估和营养支持；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The dietitian will assess him. This case does not record a nutritional assessment or support; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 一线方案：达雷妥尤单抗联合硼替佐米、环磷酰胺和地塞米松（Dara-VCd）
name.en: First-line Dara-VCd: daratumumab with bortezomib, cyclophosphamide and dexamethasone

dose.zh-CN: 分型确认为AL型后由血液科开始。每28天为1个周期，共6个周期：达雷妥尤单抗1800 mg皮下注射（第1–2周期每周1次，第3–6周期每2周1次，之后每4周1次，自首剂起最长24个周期）；硼替佐米1.3 mg/m²皮下注射，每周1次；环磷酰胺300 mg/m²口服或静脉，每周1次（每周最多500 mg）；地塞米松每周40 mg，年龄>70岁、低体重或液体过多时减为每周20 mg（ANDROMEDA）。由血液科按心脏、肾脏和神经病变调整。
dose.en: Started by haematology once typing confirms AL. 28-day cycles, six cycles: daratumumab 1800 mg SC (weekly in cycles 1–2, every 2 weeks in cycles 3–6, then every 4 weeks, up to 24 cycles from the first dose); bortezomib 1.3 mg/m² SC weekly; cyclophosphamide 300 mg/m² orally or IV weekly (no more than 500 mg a week); dexamethasone 40 mg weekly, reduced to 20 mg weekly over 70 years, at low body weight or with fluid overload (ANDROMEDA). Haematology adjusts it for his heart, kidneys and neuropathy.

harm.zh-CN: 还没有送检沉积物分型就开始化疗：组织中有淀粉样物质、血里有单克隆蛋白，并不能证明沉积的就是轻链——老年人的转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性也常伴有单克隆蛋白，而化疗对它无效。ASH 2026指南要求对沉积物作经过验证的分型；先用已取得的组织送检分型。
harm.en: Chemotherapy before the deposit has been sent for typing: amyloid in tissue plus a monoclonal protein in blood does not prove the deposit is light chain — transthyretin amyloidosis in older people often comes with a monoclonal protein, and chemotherapy does nothing for it. ASH 2026 calls for validated typing of the deposit; send the tissue already taken for typing first.

response.zh-CN: 方案已与血液科商定，分型确认为AL型后开始第1周期。本病例没有分型结果，也没有记录这一方案（原报告用的是MP方案）；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The regimen is agreed with haematology, to start cycle 1 once typing confirms AL. This case has no typing result and does not record this regimen (the report used MP); it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 美法仑联合泼尼松（MP方案）

dose.zh-CN: 口服美法仑联合泼尼松，按周期给药（本病例没有记录原报告的剂量和周期数）。
dose.en: Oral melphalan with prednisone in cycles (this case does not record the report's doses or number of cycles).

harm.zh-CN: MP方案是原报告的选择（1997年的随机试验中优于单用秋水仙碱），现在已不作一线：先后被美法仑联合地塞米松和含硼替佐米的方案（如VCd）取代，ANDROMEDA试验（2021）中加用达雷妥尤单抗后血液学完全缓解率为53.3%，单用VCd为18.1%，6个月时心脏和肾脏缓解也更多。泼尼松还会加重水钠潴留。
harm.en: MP was the report's choice (in a 1997 randomised trial it did better than colchicine alone), but it is no longer first line: melphalan with dexamethasone and then bortezomib-based regimens such as VCd replaced it, and in ANDROMEDA (2021) adding daratumumab gave complete haematological responses in 53.3% against 18.1% with VCd, with more cardiac and renal responses at six months. Prednisone also adds salt and water retention.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。原报告也采用了MP方案；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. The report's team also used MP; the case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 安排大剂量美法仑加自体造血干细胞移植
name.en: Plan high-dose melphalan with autologous stem-cell transplant

dose.zh-CN: 诱导治疗后行大剂量美法仑预处理和自体造血干细胞移植。
dose.en: Induction, then high-dose melphalan conditioning with autologous stem-cell rescue.

harm.zh-CN: 自体移植只适合经过严格筛选的患者（EHA-ISA 2022自体移植指南）；他73岁，心脏受累，血压偏低，重度水肿，移植相关死亡风险很高。他需要的是非移植的一线治疗。
harm.en: Transplant suits only carefully selected patients (EHA-ISA 2022 transplant guideline); at 73, with cardiac involvement, low blood pressure and severe oedema, his transplant-related risk is very high. He needs non-transplant first-line treatment.

name.zh-CN: 暂不治疗，出现骨髓瘤相关器官损害（CRAB）再说
name.en: Hold treatment until myeloma-defining damage (CRAB) appears

dose.zh-CN: 出院，三个月后门诊复查M蛋白和血常规，出现CRAB再开始治疗。
dose.en: Discharge, with clinic review of the M-protein and blood count in three months and treatment only if CRAB features appear.

harm.zh-CN: 器官损害已经存在：淀粉样物质正在损害他的心脏、肾脏和神经。CRAB是IMWG 2014定义骨髓瘤的事件，不是AL型淀粉样变性开始治疗的门槛——AL型淀粉样变性本身就是治疗指征。心脏受累者不治疗进展很快，延误会失去器官恢复的机会。
harm.en: The organ damage is already here — amyloid is injuring his heart, kidneys and nerves. CRAB features are the IMWG 2014 events that define myeloma, not the threshold for treating AL amyloidosis, which is itself the indication. With the heart involved, untreated disease moves fast, and delay forfeits the chance of organ recovery.

title.zh-CN: 问清消瘦、水肿以及血糖、血压的变化
title.en: Take the history of the weight loss, the swelling and his changing glucose and blood pressure

hint.zh-CN: 体重是怎么掉下来的？水肿从哪里开始、发展到哪里？这一年他的糖尿病和血压怎么样，用着什么药？手脚和头部有什么感觉？
hint.en: How did the weight come off? Where did the swelling start and how far has it spread? How have his diabetes and blood pressure been this year, and on what treatment? What has he noticed in his hands, feet and head?

guidance.zh-CN: 他清醒，能自己回答问题。
guidance.en: He is alert and answers for himself.

title.zh-CN: 查体，并看尿蛋白、生化和心脏检查
title.en: Examine him and read the urine, blood and heart tests

hint.zh-CN: 他的舌头、淋巴结、水肿、心音和感觉各告诉你什么？心电图的电压和超声心动图的室壁厚度相符吗？他现在的血糖和血压，与多年的糖尿病、高血压相符吗？
hint.en: What do his tongue, nodes, oedema, heart sounds and sensation tell you? Do the ECG voltages fit the wall thickness on the echo? Do his glucose and blood pressure now fit years of diabetes and hypertension?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁查体；化验标本在床旁留取，心电图和超声心动图在床旁完成，结果可在病历终端或床旁查看。
guidance.en: Examine him at the bedside; bloods are taken and the ECG and echo are done there, and results are read at a records terminal or at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 找出能解释全部表现的病因并送检
title.en: Find one cause for it all and send the tests that prove it

hint.zh-CN: 什么病能同时累及舌、心脏、肾脏、神经和血压？要证实它，需要查哪些血和尿，取哪里的组织？
hint.en: What disease could involve the tongue, heart, kidneys, nerves and blood pressure at once? Which blood and urine tests, and which tissue, would prove it?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 1，并送出它需要的检查。
guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board and send the tests it calls for.

title.zh-CN: 在低血压下安全地处理水肿
title.en: Treat the swelling safely despite his low blood pressure

hint.zh-CN: 他的心脏和血压能承受多快的脱水？哪些常用药在这里反而危险？过敏史会不会改变利尿剂的选择？
hint.en: How fast can his heart and blood pressure tolerate fluid removal? Which everyday drugs would be dangerous here? Does his allergy history change the choice of diuretic?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 2，并在床旁开始治疗。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board and start treatment at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 解读回报的结果并制定治疗方案
title.en: Interpret the returned results and plan his treatment

hint.zh-CN: 回报的每一项结果各自证明了什么，又留下了什么疑问？要给疾病定名、分期并开始治疗，还缺什么？现在的一线方案是什么，对他要怎样调整？
hint.en: What does each returned result prove on its own, and what does it leave open? What is still missing before you can name the disease, stage it and treat it? What is today's first-line regimen, and how would you adjust it for him?

guidance.zh-CN: 结果已陆续回报，可在病历终端或床旁查看；在会诊板上作答决策 3和决策 4。
guidance.en: Results are back to read at a records terminal or at the bedside; answer decisions 3 and 4 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 三个月复查，并对照原报告的结局
title.en: Review him at three months and compare with the reported outcome

hint.zh-CN: 水肿消退能说明什么，不能说明什么？判断疗效要看哪些指标？利钠肽的变化够得上进展的标准吗？
hint.en: What does settled oedema show, and what does it not? Which measurements define a response? Does the change in natriuretic peptide meet the definition of progression?

guidance.zh-CN: 三个月后，他回到门诊复查。
guidance.en: Three months on, he is back in clinic for review.

prompt.zh-CN: 73岁男性，糖尿病16年、高血压10年。一年内体重下降约20 kg；5个月来双下肢水肿，进行性加重并累及阴囊；一年前停用降糖药后空腹血糖约4 mmol/L、餐后5–6 mmol/L；现停用降压药，血压约100/60 mmHg；四肢麻木、刺痛、发凉，有时头晕、眼前发黑。查体：消瘦，舌体增大，颌下淋巴结约3 cm，阴囊及双下肢重度凹陷性水肿，心音低钝，心尖部3/6级杂音，温度觉消失而振动觉存在。24小时尿蛋白1.67 g，白蛋白24.7 g/L，肌酐95–98 μmol/L，HbA1c 5.1%；心电图肢体导联低电压、Ⅰ度房室传导阻滞；超声心动图双室壁增厚、舒张功能减低、射血分数60%；利钠肽1926 ng/L。你怎么理解这些表现，下一步送什么检查？
prompt.en: A 73-year-old man with 16 years of diabetes and 10 years of hypertension. About 20 kg of weight loss in a year; five months of leg oedema, worsening and spreading to the scrotum; since stopping his diabetes medicines a year ago, fasting glucose about 4 and post-meal 5–6 mmol/L; off antihypertensives, blood pressure about 100/60 mmHg; numb, tingling, cold limbs, and dizzy spells with his vision going black. On examination: wasted, an enlarged tongue, submandibular nodes of about 3 cm, severe pitting oedema of the scrotum and both legs, muffled heart sounds with a grade 3/6 apical murmur, temperature sense lost with vibration preserved. Urine protein 1.67 g/24 h, albumin 24.7 g/L, creatinine 95–98 μmol/L, HbA1c 5.1%; ECG with low limb-lead voltage and first-degree AV block; echo with thickened walls in both ventricles, reduced diastolic function and an ejection fraction of 60%; natriuretic peptide 1926 ng/L. How do you read this, and what do you send next?

need.zh-CN: 先问清体重、水肿、血糖、血压、手脚感觉和头晕，完成查体，并看过尿蛋白、血生化、HbA1c、心电图、超声心动图和利钠肽。
need.en: First take the history of his weight, swelling, glucose, blood pressure, limb sensation and dizziness, examine him, and read the urine protein, blood chemistry, HbA1c, ECG, echocardiogram and natriuretic peptide.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病解释不了这些：舌体增大、低电压伴室壁增厚、小纤维神经病变、低血压和蛋白尿提示系统性淀粉样变性；查血清和尿免疫固定电泳及血清游离轻链，并取腹壁脂肪和骨髓活检
text.en: Diabetes cannot explain this: an enlarged tongue, low voltage with thick walls, small-fibre neuropathy, low blood pressure and proteinuria point to systemic amyloidosis — send serum and urine immunofixation with free light chains, and biopsy abdominal fat and marrow

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。消瘦、停药后血糖和血压反而下降、舌体增大、肢导低电压而双室壁增厚、温度觉受损而振动觉保留、蛋白尿伴低白蛋白——这些不能都用糖尿病解释，合在一起首先要想到系统性（AL型）淀粉样变性。ASH 2026指南以血清和尿免疫固定电泳加血清游离轻链为核心检查，对原因不明的蛋白尿也建议做；组织证据首选替代部位活检（腹壁脂肪加骨髓）；活检前先查血常规和凝血功能（淀粉样变可致获得性出血倾向，本病例没有这两项结果）。淋巴结和恶性肿瘤也要评估，但不应推迟这组检查。
feedback.en: Right. Weight loss, glucose and blood pressure falling off treatment, an enlarged tongue, low limb-lead voltage with thick walls in both ventricles, lost temperature sense with vibration preserved, and proteinuria with low albumin cannot all be put down to diabetes; together they point first to systemic (AL) amyloidosis. ASH 2026 makes serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains the core tests, and suggests them for unexplained proteinuria too; tissue proof comes first from surrogate biopsies (abdominal fat with bone marrow), after a blood count and clotting screen (amyloidosis can cause an acquired bleeding tendency; this case records neither). The nodes and cancer need assessing as well, but not at the cost of delaying these tests.

text.zh-CN: 长期糖尿病的多系统并发症：糖尿病肾病（蛋白尿、低白蛋白）、糖尿病心肌病（室壁增厚、舒张功能减低）加自主神经病变（血压偏低）；查眼底和尿白蛋白/肌酐比值，开始ACE抑制剂
text.en: Multisystem complications of long-standing diabetes: diabetic kidney disease (proteinuria, low albumin), diabetic cardiomyopathy (thick walls, impaired relaxation) and autonomic neuropathy (low pressure) — check the fundi and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio and start an ACE inhibitor

feedback.zh-CN: 这是把一切都归于糖尿病的锚定错误。糖尿病解释不了舌体增大、肢导低电压而室壁增厚（真正的心肌肥厚应当电压升高）、停药后血糖和血压自行下降以及一年瘦20 kg。KDIGO 2022对糖尿病合并高血压和白蛋白尿才推荐ACE抑制剂或ARB，他的血压只有约100/60 mmHg；ASH 2026指南建议对原因不明的蛋白尿查免疫固定电泳和游离轻链。
feedback.en: This anchors everything on diabetes. Diabetes does not explain an enlarged tongue, low limb-lead voltage with thick walls (true hypertrophy raises the voltage), glucose and blood pressure falling off treatment, or 20 kg lost in a year. KDIGO 2022 recommends an ACE inhibitor or ARB for diabetes with hypertension and albuminuria, and his pressure is about 100/60 mmHg; ASH 2026 suggests immunofixation and free light chains for unexplained proteinuria.

text.zh-CN: 恶性肿瘤所致的恶病质：消瘦、颌下淋巴结肿大和低白蛋白提示实体瘤或淋巴瘤；先做胸腹盆增强CT、淋巴结活检和肿瘤标志物，结果回来前不做其他检查
text.en: Cancer cachexia: weight loss, enlarged submandibular nodes and low albumin suggest a solid tumour or lymphoma — contrast CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis, a node biopsy and tumour markers first, holding other tests until they are back

feedback.zh-CN: 找肿瘤是合理的，淋巴结也值得评估，但这个判断解释不了舌体增大、低电压伴室壁增厚、温度觉消失而振动觉保留和蛋白尿，还把能一并说明问题的检查推后了。ASH 2026指南：怀疑AL型淀粉样变性时，查血清和尿免疫固定电泳及游离轻链，并尽早做骨髓加腹壁脂肪的替代部位活检。
feedback.en: Looking for cancer is reasonable and the nodes deserve assessment, but this does not explain the enlarged tongue, low voltage with thick walls, lost temperature sense with vibration preserved or the proteinuria, and it puts off the tests that can settle the question together. ASH 2026: when AL amyloidosis is suspected, test serum and urine immunofixation with free light chains and take surrogate biopsies (bone marrow with abdominal fat) promptly.

text.zh-CN: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭加低白蛋白血症所致的水肿：加强利尿，补充人血白蛋白，复查超声心动图，三个月后门诊随访，暂不做其他检查
text.en: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction plus oedema from low albumin: diurese harder, infuse albumin, repeat the echo and review in clinic in three months, with no further tests for now

feedback.zh-CN: 水肿确实要利尿，但“射血分数保留的心力衰竭”只是描述，不是病因。射血分数60%而双室壁增厚、肢导低电压、利钠肽1926 ng/L，提示浸润性心肌病，必须查明原因；ESC 2021心脏淀粉样变立场声明正是针对这类患者的诊断路径。三个月后再看会错过治疗时机。
feedback.en: The oedema does need diuresis, but 'heart failure with preserved ejection fraction' describes; it does not explain. An ejection fraction of 60% with thick walls in both ventricles, low limb-lead voltage and a natriuretic peptide of 1926 ng/L suggest an infiltrative cardiomyopathy whose cause must be found — the ESC 2021 position statement on cardiac amyloidosis sets out the diagnostic path for exactly this patient. Waiting three months loses time.

text.zh-CN: 多发性骨髓瘤：消瘦、蛋白尿和低白蛋白提示浆细胞肿瘤；查血清蛋白电泳、骨骼X线和骨髓穿刺就够了，组织活检和游离轻链等出现骨病变再做
text.en: Multiple myeloma: weight loss, proteinuria and low albumin suggest a plasma-cell tumour — serum electrophoresis, skeletal radiographs and a marrow are enough, with tissue biopsy and free light chains only if bone lesions appear

feedback.zh-CN: 方向接近，但不够：血清蛋白电泳可能漏掉量很少的单克隆轻链，ASH 2026指南以血清和尿免疫固定电泳加血清游离轻链为核心检查。他的舌、心脏、神经和低血压线索需要组织证据（骨髓加腹壁脂肪活检）证实淀粉样物质沉积，而不是等骨病变出现。
feedback.en: Close, but not enough: serum electrophoresis can miss a small monoclonal light chain, and ASH 2026 makes serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains the core tests. His tongue, heart, nerve and blood-pressure clues need tissue proof of deposition (bone marrow with abdominal fat), not a wait for bone lesions.

prompt.zh-CN: 你考虑系统性淀粉样变性，可能累及心脏。他阴囊和双下肢重度凹陷性水肿，白蛋白24.7 g/L，肌酐95–98 μmol/L；不用降压药血压约100/60 mmHg，有时头晕、眼前发黑；超声心动图双室壁增厚、舒张功能减低、射血分数60%；糖尿病16年，停药后空腹血糖约4 mmol/L；对磺胺类药物过敏（出过皮疹）。等结果的这几天，你怎么处理水肿和他的用药？
prompt.en: You suspect systemic amyloidosis, possibly involving the heart. He has severe pitting oedema of the scrotum and both legs, albumin 24.7 g/L and creatinine 95–98 μmol/L; off antihypertensives his blood pressure is about 100/60 mmHg, with dizzy spells and his vision going black; the echo shows thick walls in both ventricles, reduced diastolic function and an ejection fraction of 60%; 16 years of diabetes, with a fasting glucose of about 4 mmol/L off treatment; a rash with a sulfa drug in the past. While the results are awaited, how do you manage the swelling and his medicines?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 1，问过过敏史，并查过水肿和血压。
need.en: Answer decision 1 first, ask about allergies, and examine his oedema and blood pressure.

text.zh-CN: 小剂量静脉呋塞米起始，按每日体重、出入量、卧立位血压、肌酐和血钾调整；磺胺类药物皮疹不妨碍用它；不恢复降压药，不用ACE抑制剂、ARB、β受体阻滞剂和降糖药
text.en: Low-dose IV furosemide titrated to daily weight, fluid balance, lying and standing blood pressure, creatinine and potassium; the sulfonamide rash does not bar it; no antihypertensive restarted, and no ACE inhibitor, ARB, beta-blocker or glucose-lowering drug

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。他需要利尿，但增厚、充盈受限的心室依赖充盈压，血压本来就低：小剂量起始，按体重、尿量、卧立位血压和肾功能逐步调整（ESC 2021心衰指南）。ESC 2021心脏淀粉样变立场声明要求ACE抑制剂、ARB和β受体阻滞剂慎用，ACC 2023共识也指出β受体阻滞剂可能使预后变差。他说的“磺胺类”通常指磺胺类抗菌药，而呋塞米属于非抗菌性磺胺：AAAAI/ACAAI 2022药物过敏实践参数认为二者之间的交叉过敏风险极低（仍要问清是哪种药、出的是什么样的皮疹）。空腹血糖约4 mmol/L，不需要也不应该用降糖药（ADA 2026）。
feedback.en: Right. He needs diuresis, but thick, poorly filling ventricles depend on filling pressure and his blood pressure is already low: start low and titrate to weight, urine output, lying and standing pressure and renal function (ESC 2021 heart failure guideline). The ESC 2021 position statement on cardiac amyloidosis advises caution with ACE inhibitors, ARBs and beta-blockers, and the ACC 2023 pathway notes that beta-blockers may worsen outcomes. His 'sulfa' allergy is, in the usual sense, to a sulfonamide antibiotic, and furosemide is a non-antimicrobial sulfonamide: the AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 practice parameter finds minimal concern for cross-reactivity between the two (still ask which drug it was and what the rash was like). With a fasting glucose of about 4 mmol/L he needs no glucose-lowering drug, and should have none (ADA 2026).

text.zh-CN: 大剂量呋塞米持续静脉泵入并配合输注人血白蛋白，争取每天体重下降2 kg以上、尽快消肿；同时恢复他原来的降压药和降糖药，以免血压、血糖反弹，每天复查肌酐和血钾
text.en: High-dose continuous IV furosemide with albumin infusions, aiming to lose more than 2 kg a day and clear the swelling fast, while restarting his usual antihypertensives and diabetes medicines so neither rebounds, with daily creatinine and potassium

feedback.zh-CN: 水肿要利尿，但追求快速大量脱水，在充盈受限的心脏和约100/60 mmHg的血压下，容易引起低血压、晕厥和肾前性急性肾损伤；再恢复降压药更是雪上加霜。空腹血糖约4 mmol/L时恢复降糖药会引起低血糖（ADA 2026）。ESC 2021心衰指南的利尿是按尿量、体重和肾功能逐步调整的。
feedback.en: He needs diuresis, but chasing rapid, large fluid losses with a poorly filling heart and a pressure of about 100/60 mmHg invites hypotension, syncope and prerenal acute kidney injury, and restarting antihypertensives compounds it. Restarting diabetes medicines with a fasting glucose of about 4 mmol/L invites hypoglycaemia (ADA 2026). The ESC 2021 heart failure guideline titrates diuretics step by step to urine output, weight and renal function.

text.zh-CN: 因为磺胺类过敏，不用呋塞米等含磺胺结构的利尿剂；先静脉输注人血白蛋白提高胶体渗透压，抬高下肢，限制饮水，等专科会诊意见再定
text.en: Because of the sulfonamide allergy, avoid furosemide and other sulfonamide-type diuretics; give IV albumin to raise oncotic pressure, elevate the legs, restrict fluids and wait for specialist advice before deciding

feedback.zh-CN: 他出过皮疹的是“磺胺类”药，通常指磺胺类抗菌药；呋塞米属于非抗菌性磺胺，AAAAI/ACAAI 2022药物过敏实践参数认为不必因磺胺类抗菌药过敏而回避非抗菌性磺胺。只靠输白蛋白和抬高下肢，解决不了心脏和肾脏引起的水钠潴留，白蛋白带来的容量负荷对僵硬的心室也不利。
feedback.en: His rash was with a 'sulfa' drug, which in the usual sense means a sulfonamide antibiotic, while furosemide is a non-antimicrobial sulfonamide: the AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 drug allergy practice parameter does not advise avoiding non-antimicrobial sulfonamides because of a sulfonamide-antibiotic allergy. Albumin and leg elevation alone do not clear salt and water retained by the heart and kidneys, and the volume albumin adds does a stiff ventricle no favours.

text.zh-CN: 按糖尿病肾病处理：开始ACE抑制剂减少蛋白尿，加SGLT2抑制剂保护心肾，口服小剂量呋塞米消肿，门诊每月随访尿蛋白、肌酐和血钾，血压低时再减量
text.en: Treat it as diabetic kidney disease: an ACE inhibitor to cut the proteinuria, an SGLT2 inhibitor to protect heart and kidneys, low-dose oral furosemide for the swelling, and monthly clinic checks of urine protein, creatinine and potassium, easing off if the pressure drops

feedback.zh-CN: KDIGO 2022的ACE抑制剂/ARB推荐针对糖尿病合并高血压和白蛋白尿，并按可耐受的剂量调整；他不用药血压也只有约100/60 mmHg，还有头晕和眼前发黑，ACE抑制剂可致严重低血压和急性肾损伤，ESC 2021心脏淀粉样变立场声明也要求慎用。他血糖已不高，SGLT2抑制剂的利尿和降压作用会加重低血压，而病因还没查清。
feedback.en: KDIGO 2022 recommends an ACE inhibitor or ARB for diabetes with hypertension and albuminuria, titrated as tolerated; off treatment his pressure is about 100/60 mmHg with dizzy spells, so an ACE inhibitor risks profound hypotension and acute kidney injury, and the ESC 2021 position statement on cardiac amyloidosis advises caution. His glucose is no longer high, an SGLT2 inhibitor's diuretic and pressure-lowering effects add to the hypotension, and the cause is not yet known.

prompt.zh-CN: 结果回报：血清见IgG λ型单克隆条带（尿没有结果）；骨髓浆细胞30.5%，CD138（+++）、λ（++）、κ（−）；骨骼影像未见溶骨性破坏；腹壁脂肪刚果红染色阳性。本病例没有游离轻链、肌钙蛋白和组织分型的结果。这些结果证明了什么，还不能证明什么？
prompt.en: The results are back: a serum monoclonal IgG lambda band (no urine result); marrow plasma cells 30.5%, CD138 +++, lambda ++, kappa negative; skeletal imaging shows no osteolytic lesions; abdominal fat is Congo red positive. This case has no free light chain, troponin or tissue-typing result. What do these results establish, and what do they not?

need.zh-CN: 先看回报的免疫固定电泳、骨髓、骨骼影像和脂肪活检结果。
need.en: Read the immunofixation, marrow, skeletal imaging and fat biopsy results that are back.

text.zh-CN: 已证实有淀粉样物质沉积和λ型浆细胞克隆，AL λ型可能性最大；但沉积物仍需分型确认，记录中也没有骨髓瘤定义事件，应称为伴骨髓浆细胞≥10%的AL型淀粉样变性
text.en: Amyloid deposition and a lambda plasma-cell clone are established, so AL lambda amyloidosis is most likely; but the deposit still needs typing, and with no myeloma-defining event in the record it is AL amyloidosis with ≥ 10% marrow plasma cells, not proven myeloma

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。刚果红阳性证明有淀粉样物质沉积，λ限制性浆细胞和IgG λ条带证明有克隆，但两者合在一起仍不能证明每个器官里沉积的都是轻链——ASH 2026指南要求对沉积物作经过验证的分型。IMWG 2014把多发性骨髓瘤定义为克隆性骨髓浆细胞≥10%加至少一项骨髓瘤定义事件；他没有溶骨病变，肌酐95–98 μmol/L，血钙、血红蛋白和游离轻链都没有结果，所以报告的“骨髓瘤”按现行标准不能确认。
feedback.en: Right. Congo red positivity proves amyloid deposition, and lambda-restricted plasma cells with an IgG lambda band prove a clone, but together they still do not prove that the deposit in every organ is light chain: ASH 2026 asks for validated typing of the deposit. IMWG 2014 defines myeloma as clonal marrow plasma cells of at least 10% plus at least one myeloma-defining event; he has no lytic lesions, a creatinine of 95–98 μmol/L, and no calcium, haemoglobin or free light chain result, so the report's 'myeloma' cannot be confirmed by current criteria.

text.zh-CN: 已确诊多发性骨髓瘤：骨髓浆细胞超过10%加单克隆蛋白就够了，淀粉样变只是骨髓瘤的并发症；按骨髓瘤分期和治疗，不必再作沉积物分型
text.en: Multiple myeloma is proven: more than 10% marrow plasma cells with a monoclonal protein is enough, the amyloid is just a complication of the myeloma, and he is staged and treated as myeloma without typing the deposit

feedback.zh-CN: IMWG 2014要求克隆性骨髓浆细胞≥10%之外，还要有至少一项骨髓瘤定义事件（高钙血症、肾功能不全、贫血、溶骨病变，或骨髓浆细胞≥60%、受累/非受累游离轻链比值≥100、MRI多于1个局灶病变）。他没有溶骨病变，肌酐95–98 μmol/L，其余几项都没有结果；淀粉样变造成的器官损害也不算骨髓瘤定义事件。治疗首先针对的是淀粉样变。
feedback.en: IMWG 2014 needs, besides clonal marrow plasma cells of at least 10%, at least one myeloma-defining event (hypercalcaemia, renal insufficiency, anaemia, lytic bone lesions; or at least 60% marrow plasma cells, an involved-to-uninvolved free light chain ratio of at least 100, or more than one focal lesion on MRI). He has no lytic lesions, a creatinine of 95–98 μmol/L and no result for the rest, and organ damage from amyloid does not count as a myeloma-defining event. Treatment is aimed first at the amyloidosis.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病肾病和糖尿病心肌病，加意义未明的单克隆丙种球蛋白病：老年人脂肪刚果红阳性多为非特异性沉积，单克隆蛋白属于巧合；继续按糖尿病并发症处理，每年复查一次M蛋白和血常规
text.en: Diabetic kidney disease and cardiomyopathy plus a monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance: Congo red in fat is often non-specific in older people and the monoclonal protein a coincidence — keep treating diabetic complications and recheck the M-protein yearly

feedback.zh-CN: 骨髓浆细胞30.5%远超出意义未明的单克隆丙种球蛋白病的上限（<10%，IMWG 2014），再加上淀粉样物质沉积和多器官受累，这个单克隆蛋白就绝不是“意义未明”；造成器官损害的克隆必须治疗。脂肪刚果红阳性也不是可以放在一边的偶然发现。
feedback.en: Marrow plasma cells of 30.5% are far beyond the limit for a monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (below 10%, IMWG 2014), and with amyloid deposition and several organs involved this gammopathy is anything but 'of undetermined significance': a clone that damages organs must be treated. A positive Congo red stain in fat is not an incidental finding to set aside.

text.zh-CN: 可能是转甲状腺素蛋白（ATTR）心脏淀粉样变性合并偶然的单克隆蛋白：先做锝焦磷酸盐骨闪烁显像，阳性即可诊断ATTR，不需要分型，也不需要化疗
text.en: This may be transthyretin (ATTR) cardiac amyloidosis with an incidental monoclonal protein: a technetium pyrophosphate bone scan first — if positive, ATTR is diagnosed with no need for typing or chemotherapy

feedback.zh-CN: 老年男性的心脏淀粉样变性确实要想到ATTR，但有单克隆蛋白时，不能用骨闪烁显像诊断：ASH 2026指南不推荐用骨闪烁显像诊断AL型心脏淀粉样变性，Gillmore 2016的无创诊断路径只适用于已经排除单克隆蛋白的患者。舌体增大、蛋白尿和30.5%的λ型浆细胞也更支持AL型；最终要靠组织分型区分。
feedback.en: ATTR must be considered in an older man with cardiac amyloid, but a bone scan cannot make the diagnosis while a monoclonal protein is present: ASH 2026 recommends against bone scintigraphy for diagnosing AL cardiac amyloidosis, and the Gillmore 2016 non-biopsy pathway applies only once a monoclonal protein has been excluded. An enlarged tongue, proteinuria and a 30.5% lambda clone also favour AL; tissue typing settles it.

prompt.zh-CN: 你判断AL λ型淀粉样变性可能性最大（伴骨髓浆细胞≥10%），累及心脏、肾脏、神经和舌，沉积物分型尚待完成。他73岁，血压约100/60 mmHg，重度水肿正在利尿。下一步的治疗计划是什么？
prompt.en: You judge AL lambda amyloidosis most likely (with at least 10% marrow plasma cells), involving his heart, kidneys, nerves and tongue, with typing of the deposit still to come. He is 73, his blood pressure is about 100/60 mmHg and his severe oedema is being diuresed. What is the treatment plan?

text.zh-CN: 用已取得的组织送检分型，以肌钙蛋白、NT-proBNP和游离轻链分期；确认为AL后由血液科开始Dara-VCd（硼替佐米每周皮下注射，地塞米松每周20 mg），心内科共同管理
text.en: Send the tissue for typing and stage with troponin, NT-proBNP and free light chains; once AL is confirmed, haematology starts Dara-VCd (weekly SC bortezomib, dexamethasone 20 mg weekly) with cardiology sharing his care

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。先确认沉积物是轻链（ASH 2026），并用肌钙蛋白、NT-proBNP和游离轻链差值分期（Mayo 2012），以便判断风险和日后的疗效。ANDROMEDA试验（2021）中Dara-VCd的血液学完全缓解率为53.3%，单用VCd为18.1%，6个月心脏缓解41.5%对22.2%，肾脏缓解53.0%对23.9%；试验允许年龄>70岁、低体重或液体过多者把地塞米松减为每周20 mg，他三者至少占两项。他不适合移植，需要的正是非移植的一线治疗（EHA-ISA 2022）。
feedback.en: Right. First confirm that the deposit is light chain (ASH 2026), and stage with troponin, NT-proBNP and the free light chain difference (Mayo 2012) to set the risk and the yardstick for response. In ANDROMEDA (2021) Dara-VCd gave complete haematological responses in 53.3% against 18.1% with VCd, and six-month cardiac responses in 41.5% against 22.2% and renal responses in 53.0% against 23.9%; the trial let patients over 70, underweight or fluid-overloaded take dexamethasone 20 mg weekly, and he meets at least two of these. He is no transplant candidate and needs exactly this non-transplant first line (EHA-ISA 2022).

text.zh-CN: 沿用口服美法仑联合泼尼松（MP方案），按周期给药；每个周期后看水肿和白蛋白的变化，水肿消退就说明治疗有效，必要时再加周期
text.en: Oral melphalan with prednisone (MP) in cycles, judging each cycle by the oedema and the albumin — if the oedema settles the treatment is working, and further cycles are added if needed

feedback.zh-CN: MP是原报告所用的方案（报告没有记录它如何判断疗效）。MP已被淘汰：先后被美法仑联合地塞米松和含硼替佐米的VCd取代，现在ANDROMEDA试验（2021）中Dara-VCd的血液学完全缓解率为53.3%，单用VCd为18.1%，器官缓解也更多。疗效要用游离轻链和器官缓解标准判断（Palladini 2012）；利尿后水肿消退不等于缓解，泼尼松还会加重水钠潴留。
feedback.en: MP was the report's regimen (how it judged response is not recorded). MP has been superseded — by melphalan with dexamethasone, then bortezomib-based VCd, and now Dara-VCd, which in ANDROMEDA (2021) gave complete haematological responses in 53.3% against 18.1% with VCd, with more organ responses. Response is judged by free light chains and organ criteria (Palladini 2012); oedema that settles with diuretics is not a response, and prednisone adds salt and water retention.

text.zh-CN: 按骨髓瘤处理，力求最深的缓解：先用两个周期VCd诱导，然后尽快行大剂量美法仑预处理和自体造血干细胞移植，移植后再评估心脏
text.en: Treat it as myeloma and aim for the deepest response: two cycles of VCd induction, then high-dose melphalan with autologous stem-cell transplant as soon as possible, reassessing the heart afterwards

feedback.zh-CN: 自体移植只适合经过严格筛选的患者（EHA-ISA 2022自体移植指南）；他73岁，心脏受累，血压偏低，还有重度水肿，移植相关死亡风险很高。“按骨髓瘤处理”也忽略了要先确认沉积物类型、完成分期。
feedback.en: Transplant suits only carefully selected patients (EHA-ISA 2022 transplant guideline); at 73, with cardiac involvement, low blood pressure and severe oedema, his transplant-related risk is very high. 'Treat it as myeloma' also skips confirming the type of the deposit and staging the disease first.

text.zh-CN: 达不到骨髓瘤的CRAB标准，按冒烟型骨髓瘤观察：水肿控制后出院，每三个月复查M蛋白和血常规，出现器官损害再开始化疗
text.en: Without CRAB features this is smouldering myeloma: control the oedema, discharge him and recheck the M-protein and blood count every three months, starting chemotherapy only if organ damage appears

feedback.zh-CN: 这是把骨髓瘤的治疗门槛错用到AL型淀粉样变性上：器官损害已经存在——淀粉样物质正在损害他的心脏、肾脏和神经——AL型淀粉样变性本身就是治疗指征。心脏受累者不治疗进展很快，延误会失去器官恢复的机会。
feedback.en: This applies the myeloma threshold to AL amyloidosis: the organ damage is already here — amyloid is injuring his heart, kidneys and nerves — and AL amyloidosis is itself the indication for treatment. With the heart involved, untreated disease moves fast, and delay forfeits the chance of organ recovery.

text.zh-CN: 不等分型和分期，今天就由血液科开始Dara-VCd：地塞米松按标准剂量每周40 mg，硼替佐米每周两次皮下注射以求尽快缓解，心内科共同管理，分型和分期结果回来以后再核对和调整
text.en: Start Dara-VCd today with haematology, without waiting for typing or staging: the standard 40 mg weekly dexamethasone and twice-weekly SC bortezomib for the fastest response, cardiology sharing his care, and the typing checked when it comes back

feedback.zh-CN: 要快，但不能跳过分型：没有分型，化疗可能用错病（ASH 2026）。分期（肌钙蛋白、NT-proBNP、游离轻链）决定风险评估和疗效判断的基线。ANDROMEDA用的是每周1次的硼替佐米，并允许年龄>70岁、液体过多者把地塞米松减为每周20 mg；对一个血压偏低、重度水肿的73岁老人，40 mg只会加重水钠潴留。
feedback.en: Speed matters, but not at the cost of typing: without it chemotherapy may treat the wrong disease (ASH 2026). Staging (troponin, NT-proBNP, free light chains) sets the risk and the baseline for judging response. ANDROMEDA used weekly bortezomib and let patients over 70 or with fluid overload take dexamethasone 20 mg weekly; in a 73-year-old with low blood pressure and severe oedema, 40 mg only adds salt and water retention.

prompt.zh-CN: 三个月复查（他按原报告接受了利尿和MP方案）：入院时白蛋白24.7 g/L、利钠肽1926 ng/L，现在白蛋白19.9 g/L、利钠肽2026 ng/L；住院时水肿消退后出院。这次没有游离轻链、免疫固定电泳、尿蛋白、肌酐和肌钙蛋白的结果。你怎么评价他对治疗的反应？
prompt.en: Three-month review (he received the report's diuresis and MP): albumin 24.7 g/L and natriuretic peptide 1926 ng/L on admission, now 19.9 g/L and 2026 ng/L; his oedema had gone down before he was discharged. There is no free light chain, immunofixation, urine protein, creatinine or troponin result this time. How do you judge his response?

need.zh-CN: 先问他出院后的情况，并看这次复查的白蛋白和利钠肽。
need.en: Ask how he has been since leaving hospital, and read this visit's albumin and natriuretic peptide.

text.zh-CN: 还不能判断有效：水肿消退来自利尿；立即查游离轻链差值、免疫固定电泳、24小时尿蛋白、肌酐和肌钙蛋白，按血液学和器官标准评价，未达深度缓解就换用含达雷妥尤单抗的方案
text.en: Response cannot be assumed — the oedema went with diuretics: check the free light chain difference, immunofixation, 24-hour urine protein, creatinine and troponin now, judge by haematological and organ criteria, and move to a daratumumab-based regimen if it is not deep

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。疗效要按Palladini 2012的标准判断：血液学缓解看游离轻链差值和免疫固定电泳，器官缓解另有心脏和肾脏标准，而这些都没有查。白蛋白由24.7降到19.9 g/L不支持肾脏改善；利钠肽升高100 ng/L（约5%），达不到心脏进展的标准（NT-proBNP升高>30%且>300 ng/L，Palladini 2010/2012）。深度血液学缓解（非常好的部分缓解及以上）才是治疗目标，达不到就要换方案。
feedback.en: Right. Response is judged by the Palladini 2012 criteria: haematological response by the free light chain difference and immunofixation, organ response by separate cardiac and renal criteria — and none of these was measured. Albumin falling from 24.7 to 19.9 g/L does not suggest the kidneys are improving; a natriuretic peptide rise of 100 ng/L (about 5%) falls short of the cardiac progression criterion (NT-proBNP up by more than 30% and more than 300 ng/L; Palladini 2010, 2012). A deep haematological response — very good partial response or better — is the target, and falling short of it means changing treatment.

text.zh-CN: 治疗有效：水肿已经消退，白蛋白和利钠肽的小幅变化在检测误差范围内，不必加查；继续原来的MP方案，半年后门诊复查白蛋白和利钠肽
text.en: The treatment is working: the oedema has gone and the small shifts in albumin and natriuretic peptide are within test variation, so no further tests — continue MP and recheck albumin and natriuretic peptide in clinic in six months

feedback.zh-CN: 水肿消退首先是利尿的作用，不是缓解标准。Palladini 2012标准用游离轻链差值和免疫固定电泳判定血液学缓解，器官缓解另有标准，这些都没有查。白蛋白由24.7降到19.9 g/L，也不能说明肾脏在好转；半年后再看，可能让无效的治疗再拖半年。
feedback.en: Oedema that settles is first of all the diuretic at work, not a response criterion. Palladini 2012 judges haematological response by the free light chain difference and immunofixation, with separate organ criteria — none of which was measured. Albumin falling from 24.7 to 19.9 g/L does not suggest the kidneys are improving, and waiting six months may waste half a year on ineffective treatment.

text.zh-CN: 心脏病变已经进展：利钠肽从1926升到2026 ng/L，说明心脏受累加重，化疗已没有意义；停用MP方案，只保留利尿等心衰支持治疗，并与他商量转入安宁疗护，以后不再复查血液指标
text.en: The heart disease has progressed: natriuretic peptide rising from 1926 to 2026 ng/L means worse cardiac involvement and chemotherapy is futile — stop MP, keep only diuretics and other heart-failure support, discuss palliative care with him and stop checking his blood tests

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告确实把三个月时的结果解读为心脏受累加重（并没有记录停止治疗），但一次升高100 ng/L（约5%）达不到公认的心脏进展标准（NT-proBNP升高>30%且>300 ng/L，Palladini 2010/2012），而且本病例连这是BNP还是NT-proBNP都没有记录。没有游离轻链结果就停止针对克隆的治疗，等于放弃唯一可能逆转器官损害的手段；是否转向姑息治疗，要在全面评估后与他本人共同决定。
feedback.en: The report did read the three-month values as worsening cardiac involvement (it records nothing about stopping treatment), but a single rise of 100 ng/L (about 5%) falls short of the accepted cardiac progression criterion (NT-proBNP up by more than 30% and more than 300 ng/L; Palladini 2010, 2012), and this case does not even record whether it was BNP or NT-proBNP. Stopping clone-directed treatment without a free light chain result abandons the only thing that can reverse the organ damage; any move to palliation is decided with him after a full assessment.

text.zh-CN: 主要问题是营养不良和低白蛋白：输注人血白蛋白到30 g/L以上，加强营养，化疗方案不变，三个月后再查
text.en: The main problem is malnutrition and low albumin: infuse albumin to above 30 g/L, build up his nutrition, keep the chemotherapy as it is and recheck in three months

feedback.zh-CN: 营养支持确实需要，但白蛋白下降可能反映尿蛋白丢失、营养和病情本身——这次都没有查；输白蛋白只能短暂提高数值，不治疗病因，还会增加容量负荷。关键是确认克隆是否得到控制：没有游离轻链和尿蛋白结果就“方案不变”，可能让无效的治疗再拖三个月。
feedback.en: Nutritional support is needed, but falling albumin may reflect urinary losses, nutrition or the illness itself — none measured this time; albumin infusions raise the number briefly, treat nothing and add volume. The question is whether the clone is controlled: keeping the regimen unchanged without free light chain or urine protein results may waste three more months on ineffective treatment.

text.zh-CN: 问清体重下降、水肿、停药后的血糖和血压、四肢感觉和头晕、食欲和排便，并追问气短、骨痛、过敏史和用药
text.en: Took the history of the weight loss, the swelling, glucose and blood pressure off treatment, limb sensation and dizziness, appetite and bowels, and asked about breathlessness, bone pain, allergies and medicines

text.zh-CN: 查看一般情况、舌、颌下淋巴结和水肿，听诊心脏，检查温度觉和振动觉，并测血压
text.en: Looked at his general state, tongue, submandibular nodes and oedema, listened to his heart, tested temperature and vibration sense and measured his blood pressure

text.zh-CN: 看过入院时的24小时尿蛋白、血生化、HbA1c、心电图、超声心动图和利钠肽
text.en: Read the admission urine protein, blood chemistry, HbA1c, ECG, echocardiogram and natriuretic peptide

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断糖尿病解释不了全部表现，并锁定系统性淀粉样变性需要的检查（决策 1）
text.en: Judged at the first attempt that diabetes could not explain the picture and chose the tests for systemic amyloidosis (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 在入院阶段就送检血清和尿免疫固定电泳、血清游离轻链，并安排腹壁脂肪和骨髓活检
text.en: Sent serum and urine immunofixation and serum free light chains and arranged abdominal fat and bone marrow biopsies while still in the admission phase

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择谨慎的静脉袢利尿和监测方案，并开始利尿和监测（决策 2）
text.en: Chose cautious IV loop diuresis with monitoring at the first attempt, and started both (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 没有开始或恢复降压药（包括ACE抑制剂），也没有使用降糖药
text.en: Started or restarted no blood-pressure medicine, ACE inhibitor included, and gave no glucose-lowering drug

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即分清结果证明了什么、还缺什么（沉积物分型、骨髓瘤定义事件）（决策 3）
text.en: Separated at the first attempt what the results prove from what they leave open — typing of the deposit and myeloma-defining events (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择分型、分期后用Dara-VCd，并送检分型和肌钙蛋白、请血液科、商定方案（决策 4）
text.en: Chose typing and staging followed by Dara-VCd at the first attempt, sent typing and troponin, involved haematology and agreed the regimen (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 没有用MP方案，没有安排自体移植，也没有“等出现CRAB再治疗”
text.en: Gave no MP, planned no transplant and did not hold treatment until CRAB features appeared

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按血液学和器官标准评价疗效，并在复查时送检游离轻链和尿蛋白（决策 5）
text.en: Judged response by haematological and organ criteria at the first attempt, and sent free light chains and urine protein at the review (decision 5)

text.zh-CN: 向他解释诊断、尚未确定之处和治疗选择，回应他“是不是不好的病”“糖尿病是不是好了”的担心
text.en: Explained the diagnosis, what is still uncertain and the treatment choices, and answered his worries about 'something bad' and whether his diabetes has gone

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge框架评价对患者的解释：先问他已经知道什么、最担心什么（他担心是“不好的病”，又以为糖尿病“自己好了”）；用通俗的话说明：一种异常的蛋白沉积在心脏、肾脏、神经和舌头里，来源于骨髓里异常的浆细胞——这是一种血液病，需要血液科治疗，但不等于已经确诊骨髓瘤，沉积物的类型还要化验确认；解释血糖、血压不用药反而正常，是这个病的表现，不是糖尿病好了，所以不能自己恢复降糖药或降压药；说明利尿要慢慢来、每天称体重，头晕时要坐下或躺下并告诉护士；说明现在的治疗（每周的注射和口服药）和以后怎样判断疗效——看血液化验，而不只看腿肿消没消；诚实地说明心脏受累使病情严重，但治疗有机会让器官恢复，不作虚假保证；分步讲，留出提问时间，请他复述要点（teach-back），并问他希望家里谁一起参与决定。本病例没有记录与他的谈话。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the explanation to the patient with the Calgary–Cambridge guide: first ask what he already knows and what worries him most (he fears 'something bad' and thinks his diabetes has 'gone away'); explain in plain words that an abnormal protein is being laid down in his heart, kidneys, nerves and tongue, made by abnormal plasma cells in the bone marrow — a blood condition that haematology treats, but not proven myeloma, and the type of the deposit still has to be confirmed; explain that glucose and blood pressure being normal without his medicines is part of this illness, not his diabetes getting better, so he must not restart those medicines himself; explain that the swelling will be cleared slowly, with daily weights, and that he should sit or lie down and call the nurse if he feels dizzy; describe the treatment (weekly injections and tablets) and how response will be judged — by blood tests, not only by the swelling; be honest that heart involvement makes this serious while treatment gives the organs a chance to recover, without false reassurance; go step by step, leave room for questions, check understanding by teach-back, and ask whom he would like involved in decisions. This case does not record any conversation with him.

name.zh-CN: 郝医生（内科主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，按PEARLS引导复盘，例如：“一个用了十几年药的糖尿病、高血压病人，停药后血糖和血压反而正常了，你会怎么想？”“室壁增厚本该电压升高，电压低说明什么？”“温度觉没了、振动觉还在，是哪一类神经纤维受累？”“要证实你的想法，血、尿和组织各要查什么？为什么要同时送？”“刚果红阳性加单克隆蛋白，能不能直接说是AL型？”“报告诊断骨髓瘤，按IMWG 2014还缺什么？”“血压低、心脏僵硬的人怎样利尿？哪些药不能加？”“三个月时怎样判断治疗有没有效？”。可以讲ASH 2026诊断指南、IMWG 2014、Palladini 2012疗效标准、ANDROMEDA试验、ESC 2021心脏淀粉样变立场声明、ACC 2023共识、KDIGO 2022、ADA 2026和AAAAI/ACAAI 2022的相关原则。原报告的处理（利尿和MP方案）是历史记录，到病例结束时再与现行指南对照。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局；游离轻链、尿免疫固定电泳、沉积物分型、肌钙蛋白、血常规、血钙、眼底、卧立位血压、利钠肽的检测类型以及利尿剂和MP方案的剂量都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has and leads the debrief in PEARLS order, for example: 'A man treated for years for diabetes and hypertension now has normal glucose and blood pressure off his drugs — what does that make you think?', 'Thick walls should raise the voltage — what does low voltage tell you?', 'Temperature sense gone and vibration kept — which nerve fibres are involved?', 'What would you send from blood, urine and tissue to prove your idea, and why all at once?', 'Congo red positivity plus a monoclonal protein — is that AL proven?', 'The report called it myeloma — what is missing by IMWG 2014?', 'How do you diurese a man with low blood pressure and a stiff heart, and which drugs must you not add?', 'How would you know at three months whether treatment is working?'. May explain the relevant principles of the ASH 2026 diagnosis guideline, IMWG 2014, the Palladini 2012 response criteria, the ANDROMEDA trial, the ESC 2021 cardiac amyloidosis position statement, the ACC 2023 pathway, KDIGO 2022, ADA 2026 and AAAAI/ACAAI 2022. The report's management (diuresis and MP) is a historical record compared with current guidance only at the end of the case. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the outcome early; free light chains, urine immunofixation, typing of the deposit, troponin, the blood count, calcium, the fundi, lying and standing blood pressure, the type of natriuretic peptide assay and the diuretic and MP doses are not recorded — do not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房责任护士。交班（ISBAR）：73岁男性，糖尿病16年、高血压10年；近一年体重下降约20 kg，近5个月双下肢水肿，逐渐加重并累及阴囊；目前血压约100/60 mmHg。可以协助建立静脉通路、留取血尿标本和24小时尿、协助骨髓和腹壁脂肪活检、给药；每天晨起称体重、记出入量、测卧位和立位血压。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（比如心率、体重、身高、卧立位血压的数值）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 73-year-old man, 16 years of diabetes and 10 of hypertension; about 20 kg of weight loss over the past year and five months of leg swelling, worsening and now involving the scrotum; blood pressure about 100/60 mmHg. Can place a cannula, take blood and urine samples and collect a 24-hour urine, assist with the marrow and fat biopsies, give medicines, and weigh him each morning, chart fluid balance and take lying and standing blood pressures. Reads back orders and reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (his heart rate, weight, height or lying and standing readings).

knowledge.zh-CN: 血液科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的血液学和病理结果。可以讲：寻找单克隆蛋白的核心检查（血清和尿免疫固定电泳加血清游离轻链，ASH 2026）；替代部位活检（骨髓加腹壁脂肪）和沉积物分型（常用质谱）的意义——刚果红阳性加单克隆蛋白仍不能证明沉积的是轻链，老年人的ATTR也可伴单克隆蛋白；IMWG 2014骨髓瘤定义事件与“伴骨髓浆细胞≥10%的AL型淀粉样变性”的区别；用肌钙蛋白、NT-proBNP和游离轻链差值分期（Mayo 2012）；Dara-VCd的用法（ANDROMEDA，2021）和老年、液体过多时地塞米松减量；按Palladini 2012标准判断血液学和器官缓解；自体移植只适合经过严格筛选的患者。不说出诊断结论，不补充病例没有记录的数值。
knowledge.en: Haematology consultant who interprets only haematology and pathology results the learner has already read. Can explain: the core tests for a monoclonal protein (serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains, ASH 2026); surrogate biopsies (marrow with abdominal fat) and typing of the deposit (usually by mass spectrometry) — Congo red plus a monoclonal protein still does not prove the deposit is light chain, and ATTR in older people can come with a monoclonal protein; the IMWG 2014 myeloma-defining events and how they differ from AL amyloidosis with at least 10% marrow plasma cells; staging with troponin, NT-proBNP and the free light chain difference (Mayo 2012); Dara-VCd as given in ANDROMEDA (2021), with dexamethasone reduced for age and fluid overload; judging haematological and organ response by the Palladini 2012 criteria; and transplant only for carefully selected patients. Does not state the diagnosis and adds no values the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 心内科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的心电图、超声心动图和心脏标志物。可以讲：室壁增厚而肢导电压低的不匹配、射血分数保留时的舒张功能受限和传导阻滞在浸润性心肌病中的意义；BNP和NT-proBNP的界值不同，报告没有注明类型时不能直接套用；超声不能确诊时，单克隆蛋白阳性者可做心脏磁共振（ASH 2026），而有单克隆蛋白时不能用骨闪烁显像诊断；利尿要小剂量起始、按体重和血压调整（ESC 2021心衰指南）；ACE抑制剂、ARB和β受体阻滞剂在心脏淀粉样变中要慎用（ESC 2021立场声明；ACC 2023共识）。不说出诊断结论，不补充没有记录的数值（心率、节律、室壁厚度、瓣膜、肌钙蛋白）。
knowledge.en: Cardiology consultant who interprets only the ECG, echocardiogram and cardiac markers the learner has read. Can explain: what thick walls with low limb-lead voltage, impaired filling with a preserved ejection fraction and conduction block mean in an infiltrative cardiomyopathy; that BNP and NT-proBNP have different thresholds, so an unnamed assay cannot simply be read against either; that cardiac MRI is the next step when the echo is not diagnostic and a monoclonal protein is present (ASH 2026), while bone scintigraphy cannot make the diagnosis then; starting diuretics low and titrating to weight and blood pressure (ESC 2021 heart failure guideline); and caution with ACE inhibitors, ARBs and beta-blockers in cardiac amyloidosis (ESC 2021 position statement; ACC 2023 pathway). Does not state the diagnosis and adds no unrecorded values (rate, rhythm, wall thickness, valves, troponin).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：长期糖尿病背后的系统性淀粉样变性
title.en: Debrief: systemic amyloidosis behind long-standing diabetes

conclusion.zh-CN: 73岁男性，糖尿病16年、高血压10年，一年内体重下降约20 kg，近5个月双下肢和阴囊进行性水肿。停药后空腹血糖约4 mmol/L（HbA1c 5.1%），血压约100/60 mmHg；舌体增大，颌下淋巴结约3 cm，心尖部3/6级杂音，温度觉消失而振动觉保留。24小时尿蛋白1.67 g，白蛋白24.7 g/L，肌酐95–98 μmol/L；肢导低电压、Ⅰ度房室传导阻滞，双室壁增厚、射血分数60%，利钠肽1926 ng/L。血清IgG λ型单克隆条带、骨髓浆细胞30.5%（λ限制）和腹壁脂肪刚果红阳性，显示淀粉样物质沉积伴λ型克隆；没有溶骨病变。报告诊断为IgG λ型浆细胞骨髓瘤并系统性淀粉样变性，给予利尿和MP方案，水肿消退后出院；三个月时白蛋白19.9 g/L、利钠肽2026 ng/L，报告认为心脏受累加重。按现行标准，最可能是伴骨髓浆细胞≥10%的AL λ型淀粉样变性：先分型确认和分期，再用Dara-VCd，谨慎利尿，按游离轻链和器官标准判断疗效。
conclusion.en: A 73-year-old man, diabetic for 16 years and hypertensive for 10, lost about 20 kg in a year; for five months his legs, then his scrotum, swelled. Off treatment, fasting glucose was about 4 mmol/L (HbA1c 5.1%) and BP about 100/60 mmHg; enlarged tongue, submandibular nodes of about 3 cm, a 3/6 apical murmur, temperature sense lost with vibration kept. Urine protein 1.67 g/24 h, albumin 24.7 g/L, creatinine 95–98 μmol/L; low limb-lead voltage, first-degree AV block, biventricular thickening, EF 60%, natriuretic peptide 1926 ng/L. A serum IgG λ band, 30.5% λ-restricted marrow plasma cells and Congo red-positive fat showed amyloid with a λ clone; no lytic lesions. The report diagnosed IgG λ myeloma with systemic amyloidosis, giving diuresis and MP; the oedema went down, but at three months albumin was 19.9 g/L and natriuretic peptide 2026 ng/L, read as cardiac worsening. Today: most likely AL λ amyloidosis with ≥ 10% plasma cells — confirm the type, stage it, give Dara-VCd, diurese gently, judge by free light chains.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 先问“什么变了”：一个多年需要用药的糖尿病、高血压病人，体重、血糖和血压一起往下走，说明有一种全身性疾病正在接管病情。
keyReasoning.en: Ask what has changed, not only what he has: weight, glucose and blood pressure all falling in a man whose diabetes and hypertension once needed drugs means a systemic illness has taken over.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 把心脏检查放在一起看：肢导低电压而双室壁增厚、射血分数保留，与高血压心肌肥厚正好相反，提示心肌被浸润。
keyReasoning.en: Read the heart tests together: low limb-lead voltage with thick walls in both ventricles and a preserved ejection fraction is the opposite of hypertensive hypertrophy and points to infiltration.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 找克隆和找组织同时进行：血清和尿免疫固定电泳加游离轻链，与腹壁脂肪和骨髓活检一起送，而不是一项等一项。
keyReasoning.en: Look for the clone and the tissue at the same time: serum and urine immunofixation with free light chains alongside fat and marrow biopsies, not one after another.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 分清已经证明的（脂肪里有淀粉样物质、骨髓里有λ型克隆）和只是推断的（每个器官沉积的都是轻链、他患有骨髓瘤）。
keyReasoning.en: Keep what is proven (amyloid in the fat, a lambda clone in the marrow) apart from what is assumed (that the deposit in every organ is light chain, that he has myeloma).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 心脏僵硬、可能有自主神经受累时，低血压是警报：慢慢利尿，不加任何会降低血压或血糖的药。
keyReasoning.en: With a stiff heart and possible autonomic involvement, low blood pressure is a warning: drain fluid gently and add nothing that lowers blood pressure or glucose.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 用克隆和器官来评价治疗，而不是看利尿剂消掉的水肿。
keyReasoning.en: Judge treatment by the clone and the organs, not by swelling a diuretic has removed.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 怀疑与诊断（ASH 2026诊断指南）：怀疑心脏淀粉样变性时推荐、原因不明的蛋白尿时建议查血清和尿免疫固定电泳加血清游离轻链，周围或自主神经病变、舌体增大也应引起同样的怀疑；组织证据首选骨髓加腹壁脂肪的替代部位活检，而不是先取肾脏或其他器官，并对沉积物作经过验证的分型。原报告依据血清IgG λ型单克隆条带、骨髓和脂肪刚果红得出诊断，记录中没有游离轻链、尿免疫固定电泳和分型。
teachingPoints.en: Suspicion and diagnosis (ASH 2026 diagnosis guideline): serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains are recommended when cardiac amyloidosis is suspected and suggested for unexplained proteinuria, and peripheral or autonomic neuropathy or an enlarged tongue should raise the same suspicion; tissue proof comes first from surrogate biopsies (marrow with abdominal fat) rather than the kidney or another organ, with validated typing of the deposit. The report reached its diagnosis with a serum monoclonal IgG lambda band, the marrow and Congo red in fat; no free light chains, urine immunofixation or typing are recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 刚果红阳性加单克隆蛋白不等于AL型：老年人的ATTR心肌淀粉样变性也常伴单克隆蛋白。Gillmore 2016的无创诊断路径只适用于已排除单克隆蛋白者，ASH 2026指南不推荐用骨闪烁显像诊断AL型心脏淀粉样变性；化疗前要先分型。舌体增大和30.5%的λ限制性浆细胞让AL型可能性很高，但仍需确认。
teachingPoints.en: Congo red plus a monoclonal protein is not AL proven: ATTR cardiac amyloidosis in older people often comes with a monoclonal protein. The Gillmore 2016 non-biopsy pathway applies only once a monoclonal protein is excluded, and ASH 2026 recommends against bone scintigraphy for diagnosing AL cardiac amyloidosis; type the deposit before chemotherapy. An enlarged tongue and 30.5% lambda-restricted plasma cells make AL very likely, but it still needs confirming.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 骨髓瘤还是AL型淀粉样变性（IMWG 2014）：骨髓瘤要求克隆性骨髓浆细胞≥10%加至少一项骨髓瘤定义事件（高钙、肾功能不全即肌酐>177 μmol/L或肌酐清除率<40 mL/min、血红蛋白<100 g/L、溶骨病变，或浆细胞≥60%、游离轻链比值≥100、MRI多于1个病灶）。他没有溶骨病变，肌酐95–98 μmol/L，其余没有结果，所以报告的“骨髓瘤”按现行标准不能确认；伴浆细胞≥10%的AL型淀粉样变性本身就要治疗。
teachingPoints.en: Myeloma or AL amyloidosis (IMWG 2014): myeloma needs clonal marrow plasma cells of at least 10% plus at least one myeloma-defining event (calcium, renal insufficiency — creatinine above 177 μmol/L or clearance below 40 mL/min — haemoglobin below 100 g/L, lytic lesions; or plasma cells of at least 60%, a free light chain ratio of at least 100, more than one MRI lesion). He has no lytic lesions, a creatinine of 95–98 μmol/L and no result for the rest, so the report's 'myeloma' cannot be confirmed today; AL amyloidosis with at least 10% plasma cells is treated in its own right.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗（ANDROMEDA，2021）：Dara-VCd的血液学完全缓解率53.3%，单用VCd为18.1%；6个月心脏缓解41.5%对22.2%，肾脏缓解53.0%对23.9%。达雷妥尤单抗1800 mg皮下注射，硼替佐米1.3 mg/m²每周1次，环磷酰胺300 mg/m²每周1次（最多500 mg），地塞米松每周40 mg，年龄>70岁、低体重或液体过多时减为20 mg。原报告用的是MP方案（1997年随机试验中优于单用秋水仙碱），如今已不作一线；他73岁且心脏受累，不适合自体移植（EHA-ISA 2022）。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment (ANDROMEDA, 2021): Dara-VCd gave complete haematological responses in 53.3% against 18.1% with VCd, and six-month cardiac responses in 41.5% against 22.2% and renal responses in 53.0% against 23.9%. Daratumumab 1800 mg SC, bortezomib 1.3 mg/m² weekly, cyclophosphamide 300 mg/m² weekly (at most 500 mg) and dexamethasone 40 mg weekly, cut to 20 mg over 70, at low weight or with fluid overload. The report used MP (better than colchicine alone in a 1997 randomised trial), which is no longer first line; at 73 with cardiac involvement he is no transplant candidate (EHA-ISA 2022).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 支持治疗：袢利尿剂小剂量起始，按体重、尿量、卧立位血压和肾功能调整（ESC 2021心衰指南）；ACE抑制剂、ARB和β受体阻滞剂在心脏淀粉样变中要慎用（ESC 2021立场声明；ACC 2023共识指出β受体阻滞剂可能使预后变差），KDIGO 2022的ACE抑制剂/ARB推荐针对伴高血压的糖尿病白蛋白尿；对磺胺类抗菌药出过皮疹不妨碍用非抗菌性磺胺呋塞米（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022）；血糖不用药也正常时，不再用胰岛素或磺脲类（ADA 2026第6、13节）。
teachingPoints.en: Supportive care: start a loop diuretic low and titrate to weight, urine output, lying and standing pressure and renal function (ESC 2021 heart failure guideline); use ACE inhibitors, ARBs and beta-blockers with caution in cardiac amyloidosis (ESC 2021 position statement; the ACC 2023 pathway notes beta-blockers may worsen outcomes), KDIGO 2022's ACE inhibitor or ARB recommendation being for diabetic albuminuria with hypertension; a rash with a sulfonamide antibiotic is no bar to furosemide, a non-antimicrobial sulfonamide (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022); and with normal glucose off treatment, insulin and sulfonylureas stay stopped (ADA 2026, sections 6 and 13).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 疗效评价（Palladini 2012；Palladini 2010）：血液学缓解看游离轻链差值和免疫固定电泳，目标是非常好的部分缓解及以上；NT-proBNP升高>30%且>300 ng/L才算心脏进展。原报告三个月时利钠肽由1926升到2026 ng/L（约5%）就判断心脏受累加重，而记录中没有游离轻链结果；水肿消退也不能当作缓解。
teachingPoints.en: Judging response (Palladini 2012; Palladini 2010): haematological response is read from the free light chain difference and immunofixation, aiming for a very good partial response or better; cardiac progression needs an NT-proBNP rise of more than 30% and more than 300 ng/L. At three months the report read a rise from 1926 to 2026 ng/L (about 5%) as worsening cardiac involvement, with no free light chain result recorded; settled oedema is no response either.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，而且本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能证明任何治疗的效果，也不能确定沉积物的类型。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。各项检查的具体时间没有记录：本病例把首批化验和心脏检查放在入院阶段，把免疫固定电泳、骨髓、骨骼影像和脂肪活检的结果放在住院后期；病史中“现在约100/60 mmHg”的血压同时作为入院时的血压显示；三个月时的白蛋白和利钠肽被安排为一次门诊复查。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show the effect of any treatment or settle what the deposit is. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The timing of the tests is not recorded: the case places the first blood, urine and heart tests at admission and the immunofixation, marrow, skeletal imaging and fat biopsy results later in the admission; the blood pressure of 'about 100/60 mmHg now' in the history is also shown as the admission reading; and the three-month albumin and natriuretic peptide are staged as a clinic review.

unknowns.zh-CN: 沉积物分型（质谱或免疫电镜）以及刚果红染色在偏振光下的表现——沉积物是否为轻链型没有直接证据。
unknowns.en: Typing of the deposit (mass spectrometry or immunoelectron microscopy) and the Congo red appearance under polarised light — there is no direct proof that the deposit is light chain.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血清游离轻链（κ、λ、比值、差值）、尿免疫固定电泳、M蛋白定量和免疫球蛋白定量。

unknowns.zh-CN: 利钠肽是BNP还是NT-proBNP；肌钙蛋白、心脏磁共振、室壁厚度数值、瓣膜（杂音的来源）和心包——无法完成分期。
unknowns.en: Whether the natriuretic peptide was BNP or NT-proBNP; troponin, cardiac MRI, wall-thickness measurements, the valves (the source of the murmur) and the pericardium — staging cannot be completed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血常规、血钙、电解质、肝功能、凝血功能、甲状腺功能、尿常规和实验室血糖。
unknowns.en: Full blood count, calcium, electrolytes, liver tests, clotting, thyroid function, urinalysis and a laboratory glucose.

unknowns.zh-CN: 眼底检查、卧位和立位血压、心率等其他生命体征、体重和身高，以及气短、尿量、发热盗汗、骨痛的情况。
unknowns.en: Fundoscopy, lying and standing blood pressure, the heart rate and other vital signs, weight and height, and whether he had breathlessness, changes in urine, fevers or sweats, or bone pain.

unknowns.zh-CN: 他以前用过的降糖药和降压药、停药的原因、引起皮疹的磺胺类药物和反应的细节，以及其他既往史、家族史和生活史。
unknowns.en: His previous diabetes and blood-pressure medicines, why they were stopped, which sulfonamide drug caused the rash and how, and his other past, family and social history.

unknowns.zh-CN: 骨骼影像的方法、骨髓的细胞遗传学和FISH、颌下淋巴结的性质。
unknowns.en: The skeletal imaging method, marrow cytogenetics and FISH, and what the submandibular nodes were.

unknowns.zh-CN: 利尿剂的药名和剂量、MP方案的剂量和周期数、住院和出院的时间，以及三个月以后的经过。
unknowns.en: The diuretic and its dose, the MP doses and number of cycles, when he was admitted and discharged, and what happened after three months.
